The sentiment trend described shows a clear negative trajectory. Initially, the product or service was praised, but after one month, customer sentiment "took a noticeable dive." This shift is characterized by widespread complaints on social media regarding poor customer service and unresolved issues, as well as a loss of confidence in previously praised features, which are now being scrutinized for failing to meet expectations. The overall pattern indicates a rapid decline in customer satisfaction and trust.
